title: MTN 5G Broadband Router (Wi-Fi 6)
shortSummary: Official MTN 5G indoor CPE Wi-Fi 6 router supporting up to 64 devices with 100GB welcome data.
description:
Official MTN 5G indoor CPE router with plug-and-play ultra-fast Wi-Fi 6 connectivity for Abuja homes and corporate offices. Connects up to 64 devices simultaneously with 100GB initial welcome data bonus.

Available for doorstep delivery across Abuja or pickup at **Suite 83 / Block B70, H&A Plaza, Wuye, Abuja**. Bulk B2B orders available via our Garki corporate desk.
